rca of the issue: N/A — no bug. The P0 offline-shift-cancellation fix is fully validated. Root cause of the ORIGINAL bug (as described in the request): resolve_player was applying a single full-window decay_needs() BEFORE maybe_autostart_shift, so after a long offline gap the character's energy was drained to <10 by the time we asked 'can this shift start?', causing valid shifts to be wrongly MISSED. The fix segments the catch-up window around the shift boundary: (1) decay only [last_resolved, start_real] as idle, (2) evaluate autostart with the START-time energy, (3) complete_activity if ends_at is now in the past, (4) decay only the post-shift remainder as idle. Working hours themselves are NOT idle-decayed. This preserves legitimate misses (already-low energy at start) and keeps future-start registrations pending.
